fields.description: When enabled, pickup and drop-off flows require the user to be within the proximity radius of the location.
fields.label: Enforce Logistics Location Check

fields.description: Maximum distance (meters) from pickup/drop-off point to treat the user as on location.
fields.label: Logistics Proximity Radius (meters)

fields.description: When enabled and the schedule/activity has planned start (and end for returns), LTTs get planned drop-off at that anchor and pickup from travel plus pickup lead. If the anchor is not set yet, LTTs still create with automatic (creation-time) planned fields and Crop Plan Schedule / On Demand Activity shows an orange notice. When disabled, planned times always use ticket creation.
fields.label: Use schedule-based LTT planned times

fields.description: Extra minutes before the activity anchor to schedule pickup, added on top of estimated travel (planned_drop_off stays at activity start/end).
fields.label: LTT pickup lead before activity (minutes)

fields.description: Average speed (km/h) used to convert distance to travel minutes.
fields.label: LTT travel avg speed (km/h)

fields.description: Multiply straight-line km to approximate road distance.
fields.label: LTT travel road factor

fields.description: Travel minutes when warehouse coordinates are missing.
fields.label: LTT travel fallback (minutes)

fields.description: When enabled, warehouse lookup for a Geo Fencing Area only returns warehouses that map back to that exact area.
fields.label: Strict Geo Area For Warehouse Lookup

fields.description: Rows per page for equipment selection in manual logistics transfer.
fields.label: Manual Transfer Equipment Page Size
